description: Java entity class representing a Product in an e-commerce system, including fields for descriptions, attributes, images, relationships, categories, and metadata such as SKU, availability, dimensions, and associations with manufacturer, store, and tax class.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Entity class representing a product with properties such as SKU, dimensions, descriptions, images, categories, manufacturer, and availability details, used within an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit information associated with the product.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for the product.

methods.name: getProductDescription
methods.description: Returns the primary product description if available.

methods.name: getProductImage
